scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc

DB.description: Create a NEW database for this installation. Do not select an existing mail database.

EMAIL_DOMAIN.description: Your verified mail domain, for example example.com (no https://).

APP_URL.description: Exact HTTPS origin where you will open UnfoldMail, e.g. https://unfoldmail.your-subdomain.workers.dev (no trailing slash).

BOOTSTRAP_SECRET.description: Generate a unique random secret of at least 32 characters. Required once to create the first administrator.
